Subject: Re: [opensuse] Screen Capture

Chris Arnold wrote:
> On 10.3, how do i get a screen capture? I have tried ctrl-print screen, 
> alt-print screen and shift-print screen but nothing works. Also googled but 
> did not find anything for opensuse. Klipper is running but don't see that it 
> has "captured" anything.

I've always used "import", a part of ImageMagick.  Just fire up a shell
and type "import foo.jpg" (or gif, or png, or whatever).  Then just
rubber-band the area you want to capture with the cursor and hit the
left mouse button.  Beep and done.  This should work with any
desktop GUI.

Regards,
Lew Wolfgang
